---
title: "Background & Grid"
subtitle: "Panel and plot backgrounds, borders, grid lines, breaks, and margins"
description: "Control panel background, plot background, panel borders, grid major/minor lines, custom breaks, and plot margins in ggplot2."
---

## Default plot

By default ggplot2 has a **grey panel** and **white grid lines**.

```r
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)
df <- data.frame(x = 1:220, y = 1:220 + rnorm(220, sd = 50))

ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point()
```

---

## Panel Background Colour

```r
# Change panel (inner plot area) background
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg, y = cyl)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#67c9ff"))

# White panel
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg, y = cyl)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))
```

---

## Panel Border

```r
# Option 1 — panel.border (recommended)
ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(
    fill  = "transparent",   # MUST be transparent — hides data otherwise
    colour = 4,              # border colour (index 4 = blue)
    linewidth = 2
  ))

# Option 2 — panel.background colour argument
ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(colour = 4, linewidth = 2))

# Custom border style
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(
    fill = "transparent", colour = "#e84855", linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "dashed"
  ))
```

---

## Plot Background Colour

The **plot background** is the area outside the panel — the full figure.

```r
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg, y = cyl)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "grey86"))

# Plot border
ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 2
  ))
```

---

## Using Themes for Background

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_dark()      # dark panel background

ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()   # white background, no border

ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()        # white panel, black border

ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic()   # white, no grid
```

---

## Grid Customisation

### Full grid

```r
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_line(
    colour   = "#8ccde3",
    linewidth = 0.75,
    linetype = 2          # 1=solid, 2=dashed, 3=dotted
  ))
```

### Major grid

```r
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(
    colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = 2
  ))

# Only vertical major lines
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = 2))

# Only horizontal major lines
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = 2))
```

### Minor grid

```r
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "tomato", linewidth = 0.25))

# Only minor x lines
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "tomato", linewidth = 0.25))

# Only minor y lines
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(colour = "tomato", linewidth = 0.25))
```

---

## Custom Grid Breaks

```r
# Custom Y-axis breaks (every unit 10–35)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 35, by = 1))

# Custom X-axis breaks
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(50, 350, by = 25))

# Major and minor breaks
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks       = seq(50, 350, by = 25),
    minor_breaks = seq(50, 350, by = 10)
  )

# Set number of major breaks (approximate)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 20)
```

---

## Removing Grid Lines

```r
# Remove ALL grids
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

# Remove only major
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank())

# Remove only minor
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Common clean style — remove minor, keep major
ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

---

## Plot Margins

```r
library(ggplot2)

# Default margins
ggplot() +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, geom = "density",
                xlim = c(-4, 4), fill = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.1)) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = 1, linewidth = 1))

# Increase margins (in points — default unit)
ggplot() +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, geom = "density",
                xlim = c(-4, 4), fill = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.1)) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(colour = 1, linewidth = 1),
    plot.margin     = margin(
      t = 20,   # Top
      r = 50,   # Right
      b = 40,   # Bottom
      l = 10    # Left
    )
  )

# In centimetres
ggplot() +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, geom = "density",
                xlim = c(-4, 4), fill = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.1)) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 1, r = 1, b = 3, l = 2, unit = "cm")
  )

# Remove margins
ggplot() +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, geom = "density",
                xlim = c(-4, 4), fill = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.1)) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## Remember TRBL
`margin()` order: **T**op, **R**ight, **B**ottom, **L**eft — the word **TRou BL**e helps remember it.
:::

---

## Full Custom Background Example

```r
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#e84855", "#2d6be4", "#12a36a")) +
  labs(title = "Custom Background & Grid", colour = "Cylinders") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "#f0f4f8", colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "#ffffff", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major  = element_line(colour = "#dce3ec", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.border      = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = "#c8d0dc"),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position   = "top",
    plot.margin       = margin(16, 16, 16, 16)
  )
```
